title: Container Management Automation (Bootstrap + Install) (v1)
acceptance_criteria: System -> Containers shows a Setup Required screen until SSH is enabled and the VyManager automation key is installed.
The Setup action is idempotent and applies: `set service ssh` and installs a public key under `system login user vyos authentication public-keys vymanager`.

The Install action pulls the container image via SSH (`add container image ...`), creates missing `/config/containers/*` host paths for volumes, then commits the container configuration via the VyOS HTTPS API.
Template usage does not auto-install; users can Populate, edit settings, then click Install explicitly.
Container web links can be opened using a user-selected host/interface IP (default prefers private static interface addresses over the instance host).
Automated backend tests exist for bootstrap + install happy paths.
assumptions: VyOS HTTPS API does not support op-mode `add` commands; SSH is allowed for automation on the target instances.
The `vyos` user has passwordless sudo for the limited commands VyManager runs (`mkdir -p` under `/config/containers/` and `vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper add container image`).
Selecting a host IP for links changes only the URL VyManager opens; it does not change Podman bind behavior or firewall exposure.
